description: Na₂H₁₀SO₅ crystallizes in the orthorhombic Cmcm space group. The structure is two-dimensional and consists of two Na₂H₁₀SO₅ sheets oriented in the (np.int64(0), np.int64(1), np.int64(0)) direction. There are two inequivalent Na sites. In the first Na site, Na is bonded to six O atoms to form corner-sharing NaO₆ octahedra. The corner-sharing octahedral tilt angles are 56°. There are four shorter (2.34 Å) and two longer (2.43 Å) Na-O bond lengths. In the second Na site, Na is bonded in a 4-coordinate geometry to one S and four equivalent O atoms. The Na-S bond length is 2.91 Å. All Na-O bond lengths are 2.35 Å. There are three inequivalent H sites. In the first H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.99 Å. In the second H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. In the third H site, H is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one O atom. The H-O bond length is 0.98 Å. S is bonded in a single-bond geometry to one Na atom. There are two inequivalent O sites. In the first O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two Na and two H atoms. In the second O site, O is bonded in a distorted water-like geometry to two equivalent Na and two equivalent H atoms.
